_comment: Hand-authored paraphrase queries over the migrated MARM store.
The known-item eval (scripts/eval_recall.py) quotes a sentence verbatim out of
the target memory, handing BM25 a perfect lexical overlap it never gets in
practice -- it is a regression harness, not a tuning harness. These queries are
written the way the user actually asks: different wording, partial recollection,
sometimes just an identifier. Lane weighting is tuned against these.
Cases key on topic_match (a unique topic prefix) rather than an opaque id, so the
fixture survives a store rebuild. Migration ids are deterministic anyway, but a
readable key also makes a failing case diagnosable.
